definitions.explanation: A work into which great effort, time, and skill have been poured. Used for art, literature, film, academic papers, and other creative or intellectual endeavors.

examples.japanese: ⟦{三|さん}{年|ねん}→三年：10984_sannen⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦{完成|かんせい}させた→完成させる：02519_kanseisaseru⟧{力作|りきさく}だ。
examples.english: It's a painstaking work that took three years to complete.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{映画祭|えいがさい}→映画祭：30642_eigasai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界中|せかいじゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{力作|りきさく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: Ambitious works from around the world gathered at this film festival.

notes:
{力作|りきさく} refers to a work into which great effort and dedication have been poured. It is always complimentary.

FORMS:
{力|りき} (effort, power) + ⟦{作|さく}→作：27430_saku⟧ (work, creation). Emphasizes the effort invested, not necessarily the artistic quality of the result.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{渾身|こんしん}→渾身：13349_konshin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{力作|りきさく}: a work of one's whole heart and soul
- {力作|りきさく}ぞろい: a lineup of masterpieces
- {大|だい}{力作|りきさく}: a great ambitious work
- {力作|りきさく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}する→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧: to present a major work

USAGE:
Applied to art, literature, film, music, academic papers, and even ambitious cooking or craft projects. Often used in reviews, praise, and introductions of creative works.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{傑作|けっさく}→傑作：00217_kessaku⟧: masterpiece (emphasizes quality/brilliance)
- ⟦{名作|めいさく}→名作：11869_meisaku⟧: masterpiece, classic (emphasizes lasting reputation)
- {力作|りきさく}: painstaking work (emphasizes effort invested)
